title: Law to require ferry service to West 125th Street
summary: This bill would require the mayor to establish and maintain regular ferry service to a new terminal at or near West 125th Street in Manhattan by January 1, 2028. The city or a contracted operator would run the service, connecting it to the existing NYC Ferry system and nearby transit and pedestrian infrastructure. The mayor would also have to coordinate with state and federal agencies with jurisdiction over the Hudson River waterfront.
